# Puerto

> Puerto is an open-source (MIT) Rust framework that generates Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture backends from one manifest, puerto.toml: a Cargo workspace with business, infrastructure and presentation crates, plus a React frontend typed from the API's OpenAPI spec. It is a code generator (the `puerto` CLI) and a set of runtime crates (puerto-core, puerto-web, puerto-sqlx, puerto-events, puerto-kafka, puerto-mail, puerto-auth) updated with `cargo update`.

Install with `cargo install puerto --locked`. HTTP is poem with poem-openapi; the database is Postgres through SQLx. Puerto is pre-1.0: minor versions can change generated code and come with a migration guide.

## Start

- [What Puerto is](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/): the two halves (generator and runtime) and the three principles.
- [Quick start](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/start/quick-start/): from an empty directory to a CRUD API with screens.
- [The architecture](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/start/architecture/): the dependency rule, a request end to end, and what the compiler enforces.

## Guides

- [Entities and fields](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/entities/): `puerto generate scaffold`.
- [Use cases](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/use-cases/): custom use cases, endpoints and their tests.
- [Database and migrations](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/database/): `--db`, SQLx offline cache, migrations.
- [Domain events](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/events/): transactional outbox, worker, consumers, Postgres or Kafka transport.
- [Mail](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/mail/): mail ports, templates, sent once per event.
- [Authentication](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/auth/): OIDC (Auth0, Keycloak) or local accounts, roles per route.
- [The web frontend](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/web/): React + daisyUI on Bun, typed from OpenAPI.
- [Working with agents](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/guides/agents/): AGENTS.md, compiler feedback, review tiers.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/reference/cli/)
- [puerto.toml](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/reference/puerto-toml/)
- [Error contract](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/reference/errors/)
- [Decisions (ADRs)](https://puerto-rs.vercel.app/docs/decisions/)

## What Puerto is not

- Not a web framework or an ORM: it decides how poem, SQLx and the rest fit together.
- Not MVC: business rules live in a `business` crate that depends on no framework.
- Source: https://github.com/Guuri11/Puerto · Author: Sergio Gurillo
